title: Cloaking
summary: Matt Cutts of Google explains what cloaking is: serving different content to search engine crawlers than to users. He covers why it violates Google's webmaster guidelines.
why: Cited as the authoritative definition of cloaking when discussing paywall bypasses, Quora, and A/B testing.

quote.text: Cloaking is essentially serving different content to users than Googlebot".
